sentences.text:
Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Kundan Kumar, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Sadanand Paswan, A.P.P.
 ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ARVIND SRIVASTAVA  ORAL ORDER 2 19-10-2023 1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. Petitioner apprehends arrest in connection with Bibhutipur P.S. Case No. 105 of 2023 registered for the offences under Sections 341, 342, 323, 366-A, 376-D, 504, 506 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3 (1) (r), 3(1)(s) of the SC/ST (POA) Act & Section 3 & 8 of the POCSO Act.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the instant case.

Further submission is that this case is counter blast of the case which the father of the petitioner has filed against the informant before the Sarpanch numbered Case No.
17 of 2022 as contained at Annexure-P-3.

It is also submitted that the Patna High Court CR. MISC.
No.67239 of 2023(2) dt.19-10-2023 informant is a habitual litigant as she filed complaint case against the petitioner vide complaint case No. 343 of 2022 at Annexure-P-4 and she also lodged another FIR against the other persons vide Bibhutipur P.S. Case No. 194 of 2020 dated 16.07.2020 annexed at Annexure-5.

4. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and the submissions advanced on behalf of the parties, the petitioner, above named is directed to be released on bail, in the event of arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a period of four weeks from today, on furnishing Raushan Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98751826/
